# High6251 complete rational certificate tables

This appendix expands all frozen profiles and physical leaves from the matching exact checker. Every rational is exact; the decimal reserves are diagnostic only. The complete binary cover and all predicates remain in the JSON receipt.

## Complete Schur profiles

Each triple is `(j, nn, W)`, meaning `t=j/200`, `nu=nn/10000`, and the integer contour width `W`. Every triple is retained.
